identity.message: CSRF vulnerability due to protection being disabled.

findings.justification: The actual SecurityConfig accepts JWT credentials only from an explicit Authorization header. RSA/Nimbus verified regressions show cookies, authenticated sessions, query and form credentials cannot authorize a mutation; a header-authorized request creates no authentication session. Applies only to this exact authentication configuration. The independent Tomcat11.0.27 patch addendum binds the sole managed-version POM delta and actual69/69 Java regressions, including the same4 Bearer-only tests; every authentication implementation/client/test source byte remains unchanged.
